en_title: The GTA Leaker Who Revealed Lucia — After Hacking Rockstar Through His Hotel TV — Pleads Guilty
cn_title: 通过酒店电视入侵Rockstar、曝光Lucia的GTA泄密者认罪
opus_summary: 曾通过酒店电视等设备入侵Rockstar、首次泄露《GTA6》角色Lucia的Arion Kurtaj，已对相关网络犯罪和勒索未遂认罪。他还承认袭击收押设施工作人员，目前正等待判刑；若被判监禁，他在安全精神病院度过的时间是否会被计入刑期尚不清楚。

paragraphs.en: Arion Kurtaj, the Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker who first revealed Lucia to the world, has pleaded guilty to cybercrimes in relation to his 2022 hack of Rockstar . He also pleaded guilty to attempting to extort Rockstar, and to attacking workers at a facility where he was being detained after the hack.
paragraphs.cn: 首次向世界曝光Lucia的《GTA6》泄密者Arion Kurtaj，已承认与其2022年入侵Rockstar有关的网络犯罪。他还承认曾试图勒索Rockstar，并袭击了入侵事件后关押他的设施中的工作人员。

paragraphs.en: Kurtaj, who is now 21, was 17 when he was initially taken into custody over the 2022 Rockstar hack. As he is from the U.K., he could not initially be named as a minor. He was also deemed unable to stand trial due to the severity of his autism, and was instead sent to be held indefinitely in a secure psychiatric facility . Now, as reported by the BBC , he has been deemed able to stand trial and has entered a guilty plea.
paragraphs.cn: 现年21岁的Kurtaj因2022年入侵Rockstar事件最初被拘押时年仅17岁。由于他来自英国，作为未成年人，他的姓名最初不能被公开。由于自闭症程度严重，他还被认定无法接受审判，转而被送往一家封闭式精神病治疗机构无限期关押。如今，据BBC报道，他已被认定能够接受审判，并作出了有罪答辩。

paragraphs.en: The 2022 hack resulted in the first major GTA 6 leak, as early gameplay footage was shared online. Here, we saw Jason and Lucia for the first time, as they held victims at gunpoint. These clips were shared under the online name TeaPotUberHacker. Rockstar refused to pay Kurtaj's ransom.
paragraphs.cn: 2022年的入侵导致了《GTA6》首次重大泄密，早期游戏实机画面被分享到网上。我们在这些画面中第一次看到了Jason和Lucia，两人正持枪威胁受害者。这些片段以TeaPotUberHacker的网名发布。Rockstar拒绝支付Kurtaj索要的赎金。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, this was our first confirmation that GTA 6 would star a female protagonist, a first in modern GTA games.
paragraphs.cn: 关键的是，这是我们首次确认《GTA6》将由一名女性担任主角，这在现代《侠盗猎车手》游戏中尚属首次。

paragraphs.en: It would be over a year before Rockstar finally confirmed this itself, and even longer until we got an official gameplay reveal, which was only shared in August of this year.
paragraphs.cn: 一年多后，Rockstar才最终亲自证实了这一点，而我们等到官方公布实机画面的时间更久——该画面直到今年8月才发布。

paragraphs.en: It wasn't just the leaked material that brought attention to this hack in 2022, but also the method in which Kurtaj pulled it off. At the time, police were housing him in a hotel after he was apprehended for previous hacks, fearing he would be targeted by rival hackers. Using his hotel TV, an Amazon Fire Stick, and a Bluetooth mouse and keyboard, Kurtaj was able to breach Rockstar, taking gameplay clips and files.
paragraphs.cn: 2022年，令这次入侵受到关注的不仅是泄露的材料，还有Kurtaj实施入侵的方式。当时，他因此前的入侵行为被捕后，警方担心他会成为敌对黑客的目标，便将他安置在一家酒店。Kurtaj利用酒店电视、一支Amazon Fire Stick以及蓝牙鼠标和键盘，成功入侵Rockstar，取得了游戏片段和文件。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar claims that the hack cost them $5 million to recover from. It further claimed that the Lucia reveal was being kept underwraps for the marketing campaign, something that Kurtaj's leaks spoiled.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar称，这次入侵使其花费了500万美元进行恢复。该公司还称，Lucia的亮相原本被保密，准备留待营销活动时公布，但Kurtaj的泄密破坏了这一计划。

paragraphs.en: However, it isn't just these crimes related to the hack that Kurtaj was facing. The BBC also notes that the 21 year old pleaded guilty to physical assaults, in relation to biting workers at the facility where he was being kept.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Kurtaj面临的并不只有这些与入侵有关的罪行。BBC还指出，这名21岁的男子就人身攻击罪认罪，该罪名与他咬伤关押他的设施中的工作人员有关。

paragraphs.en: Kurtaj is awaiting his sentencing. It is unclear if his time at the secure facility will be taken into account should he recieve a custodial sentence.
paragraphs.cn: Kurtaj正在等待宣判。如果他被判处监禁，目前尚不清楚他在封闭式设施中度过的时间是否会被考虑在内。
